datevExportFormatHelp: DATEV expects Western European character encoding (LATIN-1, cp1252). The "Strict with Abort" setting does not allow non-encodable characters in the DATEV export and aborts it with an error message. The "Strict with Replacements" setting attempts to use similar characters (e.g. c instead of ć) and additionally outputs a warning during DATEV export. The "Lax (UTF-8)" setting ignores this requirement and passes the data in the kivitendo-compliant UTF-8 format.

crm_fields.lxcarsMechanicModeEnabled_help:
Enables the mechanic mode for workshop tablets.

The mechanic sees only orders where they are assigned to a work instruction. They can:
• Check off instructions and enter actual times
• Edit positions
• Record defects
• Request spare parts (with optional photo)

The workshop manager sees pending part requests in the info bar and can mark them as ordered with supplier selection.

Tablet detection is automatic based on screen size.

crm_fields.wallDisplayEnabled_help:
Enables the wall display feature for a large screen (e.g. 65" TV on the wall). Setup:

1. Create a regular user (e.g. "Display")
2. Go to user configuration → Startup view → select "Wall display"
3. Open the browser on the display in kiosk mode: chromium --kiosk http://your-address:5173
4. After login the display automatically shows the calendar

When an employee clicks the monitor icon in an invoice/order, the display switches to the document view (positions, customer, vehicle). Ideal for showing the order to the customer.
crm_fields.wallDisplaySize_help:
Controls the size of UI elements and fonts on the wall display.

• Auto: landscape screens (TV) get the compact rendering, portrait screens (wall tablet) the large one.
• Compact: small toolbar and fonts so the calendar fills as much space as possible — best for TVs.
• Normal: FullCalendar default sizes.
• Large: deliberately large fonts and buttons, readable from a few meters away — ideal for portrait wall tablets.
